title: SQL Injection – Administrator Login Bypass
payload_used: TO VERIFY: record the exact email-field payload that successfully bypasses login
impact: If confirmed, an attacker may bypass authentication and access the administrator account without valid credentials.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for authentication lookups. Enforce secure password verification and generic authentication errors.

title: SQL Injection – Product Search Data Extraction
payload_used: TO VERIFY: record the exact UNION-based search payload that returned unintended records
impact: If confirmed, an attacker may manipulate the product-search query to retrieve database records that should not be exposed, potentially including user information.
remediation: Use parameterized queries for search terms, avoid building SQL with string concatenation, and restrict database-account permissions to the minimum required.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in Search
url_or_endpoint: GET /rest/products/search?q= (search input reflected in the page)
payload_used: TO VERIFY: record the exact reflected-XSS payload that executed in the browser
impact: If confirmed, an attacker may craft a link that causes script to execute in a victim's browser when the victim opens the link, potentially acting with the victim's application session privileges.
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding to all untrusted values, sanitize HTML where HTML input is required, and use a restrictive Content Security Policy as defense in depth.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Customer Feedback
url_or_endpoint: POST /api/Feedbacks/ (verify exact request URL in DevTools)
impact: The feedback submission was accepted and the test comment appeared in the API response. Script execution when the stored comment is later displayed has NOT yet been confirmed; if confirmed, viewers of the affected page may execute attacker-controlled script in their browsers.
remediation: Encode untrusted feedback when rendering it, sanitize any permitted rich-text input with a maintained allowlist sanitizer, and avoid unsafe DOM insertion methods.
